title: 第二十三章 晨间运动第二十四章 回归与挑战枯叶道馆
content_zh:
“嘶~”好痛，林萧醒过来捂着头闷声道，宿醉过后脑袋里就像几千根针扎一样剧痛无比。
使劲摇晃脑袋，林萧从散落在床头的衣服兜里掏出烟，点上一根，开始吞云吐雾气。
抽完一根烟，才感到脑袋的刺痛减缓不少，林萧抬手在像个八爪鱼死死抱住自己的花子臀部捏了几下。
“还不起床？太阳都晒屁股了。”
“嗯~”花子慵懒的在林萧怀里挤了挤，轻声道：“唔~，不要闹，让我再睡会，昨天晚上好累，差点被你玩死。”
“嘿嘿！”林萧用手抓住花子胸前的大白兔，揉捏了几下，“花子，你说我们是不是做下晨间运动？有助于身心健康哦。”
胸前的大白兔被林萧握住，无法继续睡觉的花子睁开眼睛，妩，媚的丢给他一个白眼。
“伺候了你半晚上还不满足？真不知道年纪不大，鬼主意倒是挺多。”
“花子姐，你太让我伤心了，”林萧做出欲哭模样，委屈道：“人家第一次就这样给了你，没想到你这么无情，我这颗幼小的心灵严重受创.....”
花子无奈的白了林萧一眼，柔声道：“好了啦，别装了，真是。都已经成年了还像个小孩子一样，真拿你没办法。”
伸出手在林萧脸上，轻轻摩擦着，“说吧，要姐姐怎么补偿你，只要不是太过份的要求，姐姐可以考虑一下。”
“补偿？”林萧双眼一亮，仔细思考，可想了一会硬是想不出让花子怎么补偿自己的方法。
捏在花子臀部的手，不自觉的加大了力道。
“把手拿开，你捏痛我了，”花子扭动臀部，娇声道。
谁知花子一扭动，林萧的手指随着滑落触碰到花子臀瓣中间，手指触碰到花子后面的小花。
林萧心里顿时有了主意，侧过头在花子的耳边轻声嘀咕几句。
“不行，那里绝对不行。”听了林萧的话，花子脸色一变，红着脸哀声道：“好弟弟，那里不行的，我们来做晨练好不好？”
“可不是说好补偿我的吗？”林萧不依不饶的对花子打感情牌。
“就一次嘛，真的就一次。花子姐.....”
花子顿时犹豫起来，她实在想不到林萧所说的补偿居然是要玩自己后面的小花。

犹豫了半响，花子搂住林萧的脖子，轻吻着他的耳垂，略微担心的说：“那你要温柔一点知道吗？我怕会很痛......”
“得令！”
林萧一个翻身把花子压倒身下，兴奋道。
把手伸到花子的两腿间轻轻摩擦，没过多久，“唔~”花子发出令人热血沸腾的shenyin。
在林萧手指的拨弄下，花子下、面很快变得泥泞不堪。
content_en:
"Hiss~" It hurts so much. Lin Xiao woke up and muttered, covering his head. After a hangover, the pain in his head was like thousands of needles pricking him.
Shaking his head vigorously, Lin Xiao took out a cigarette from the pocket of his clothes scattered on the bedside, lit one, and began to puff away the smoke.
After smoking a cigarette, he felt the pain in his head slow down a lot. Lin Xiao raised his hand and pinched Hanako's buttocks a few times as she hugged him tightly like an octopus.
"Still not getting up? The sun is shining on your butt."
"Hmm~" Hanako lazily squeezed Lin Xiao's arms and said softly: "Hmm~, don't make trouble, let me sleep for a while. I was so tired last night and I almost died from you."
"Hey!" Lin Xiao grabbed the white rabbit on Hanako's chest with his hand and kneaded it a few times. "Hanako, do you think we should do some morning exercise? It will help our physical and mental health."
The big white rabbit on his chest was held by Lin Xiao. Hanako, who could no longer sleep, opened his eyes and gave him a charming look.
"I've been serving you for half a night and you're not satisfied? I don't know how young you are, but you have a lot of tricks up your sleeve."
"Sister Hanako, you make me so sad," Lin Xiao said aggrievedly as if he was about to cry: "This is the first time I gave it to you. I didn't expect you to be so heartless. My young heart was seriously hurt..."
Hanako gave Lin Xiao a helpless look and said softly: "Okay, stop pretending, it's true. I'm an adult and still act like a child. I really can't do anything to you."
He stretched out his hand on Lin Xiao's face and rubbed it gently, "Tell me how you want my sister to compensate you. As long as it's not too much, I can consider it."
"Compensation?" Lin Xiao's eyes lit up and he thought carefully, but after thinking for a while, he couldn't think of a way for Hanako to compensate him.
The hand that squeezed Hanako's butt unconsciously increased its strength.
"Take your hand away, you're hurting me," Hanako said sweetly, twisting her hips.
Unexpectedly, as soon as Hanako twisted, Lin Xiao's fingers slid down and touched the middle of Hanako's buttocks, and his fingers touched the small flower behind Hanako.
Lin Xiao suddenly had an idea in his mind, turned his head and whispered a few words in Hanako's ear.
"No, it definitely won't work there." After hearing Lin Xiao's words, Hanako's expression changed, and she said with a blushing face, "Good brother, it won't work there, let's do some morning exercises, okay?"
"Didn't you agree to compensate me?" Lin Xiao played the emotional card to Hanako reluctantly.
"Just once, really just once. Sister Hanako..."
Hanako hesitated immediately. She really didn't expect that the compensation Lin Xiao said was to play with the little flower behind her.
After hesitating for a while, Hanako hugged Lin Xiao's neck, kissed his earlobe gently, and said slightly worriedly: "Then you have to be gentle, you know? I'm afraid it will be very painful..."
"Got the order!"
Lin Xiao turned over and pushed Hanako down, and said excitedly.
He put his hand between Hanako's legs and rubbed it gently. After a while, "Hmm~" Hanako let out a passionate cry.
Under Lin Xiao's fingers, Hua Zi's bottom and face quickly became muddy.
